mechanism: Train a GaussianHMM (n_components=S, full/diag/tied/spherical cov) on multivariate observation rows (price features + indicators). Baum–Welch fits init probs, transition matrix, and per-state means/covariances. At runtime load JSON params into MQL5 HMM and emit hard state labels via Viterbi/MAP for each bar.
data_needed: Feature matrix with ≥2 rows and n_features columns matching the trained model; chosen S; hmmlearn GaussianHMM then hmm2json export.

mechanism: Forward–backward (log or scaling) yields α and β; posterior P(state|obs)=normalize(α⊙β). predict_state_probs returns soft probabilities per observation; transitions in the decoded sequence or jumps in max-posterior mark regime changes.
data_needed: Same observation matrix as the fitted HMM; log vs scaling implementation flag.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same demo dataset / DEX 600 UP Index M5 script host.
why_new_for_mis: Soft regime-change sensor: probability mass shifts across hidden states, not only a hard Viterbi label flip.
quote: the probability that an observation is in a particular state, is calculated as [forward×backward likelihoods via Bayes].
